title: Pin @voidbrain/bricks and adopt its tokens with a Grover theme
goal: The client takes bricks' tokens and foundations; Grover's green palette, light and dark, is a theme, and the local token block is gone
acceptance: A Grover theme sets bricks semantic tokens to today's values (light and dark); --bg, --surface, --accent, --ok/--warn/--bad, radii, spacing and font map to bricks tokens and the local definitions are removed
Foundations (.sr-only, skip link, focus ring, base body) come from bricks
Screens look unchanged: client specs and build pass; a before/after screenshot of the dashboard in light and dark is in the PR
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one dependency, one theme file, a token rename across four style sheets. Not a measurement.
